flags: Partial overview: no cache page documents the Promised Land byway’s designation, route history, full alignment, drive time or road character. Kept below the requested overview range rather than filling gaps; regional history is explicitly local history.
Town order follows material’s strip sequence. Its 106.7 mapped miles extend beyond the final listed town at mile 53.8; no complete end-to-end routing can be established from the cache.
Catahoula moment is deliberately short: the cache provides geography and census data, not a supported landmark narrative.

Church source documents authorization of a lottery, not receipts or the amount raised. The text states the authorized funding mechanism without claiming proceeds paid for the building.
